lines.zh: 履带碾过草地，压出一道沟。
lines.en: My treads crush the grass into a groove.

lines.zh: 每走一步，烟囱就吐一口黑。
lines.en: Each step, my stack coughs out black.

lines.zh: 我要找个平地，把产线支起来。
lines.en: I need level ground to set up the line.

lines.zh: 活塞腿一伸一缩，慢得像老牛。
lines.en: My piston legs extend and retract, slow as oxen.
I rattle so hard my screws jump.

lines.zh: 前面有坡，我的锅炉不喜欢坡。
lines.en: A slope ahead. My boiler hates slopes.

lines.zh: 我边走边预热，到了就能开工。
lines.en: Preheating as I walk, ready on arrival.

lines.zh: 蒸汽从缝里冒出来，白了一片。
lines.en: Steam leaks from seams and whites out the view.

lines.zh: 我投下的影子是方的，没一处圆。
lines.en: The shadow I cast is square, corner to corner.

lines.zh: 地面太软，我的底座陷进去了。
lines.en: Ground's too soft; my base is sinking.

lines.zh: 我把传送带折起来背着走。
lines.en: I fold the conveyor and carry it along.

lines.zh: 每一步都像有人在里面敲铁。
lines.en: Every step sounds like hammering inside.

lines.zh: 我要去村口，那里订单最多。
lines.en: To the village gate — most orders there.

lines.zh: 炉火不能灭，灭了就得重来。
lines.en: The fire must not die, or I start over.

lines.zh: 我压过一条田埂，麦子全倒了。
lines.en: I roll over a field ridge and the wheat goes flat.

lines.zh: 烟囱冒出的黑烟，替我标了路。
lines.en: The black smoke from my stack marks my road.
The boiler holds pressure and hisses.

lines.zh: 我在等原料，等到履带发凉。
lines.en: Waiting for stock till my treads go cold.
Station three stands empty, still unbuilt.

lines.zh: 产量不够，我得再快一点。
lines.en: Output's short. I must go faster.

lines.zh: 铆钉松了一颗，我感觉得到。
lines.en: A rivet loosened. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 传送带空转，什么也没送来。
lines.en: The belt runs empty. Nothing comes.

lines.zh: 我数着冲压的次数，一，二，一，二。
lines.en: Counting stamps: one, two, one, two.

lines.zh: 工程师还没来查我的表。
lines.en: The engineer hasn't checked my gauge.

lines.zh: 我的漆掉了一半，露出铁。
lines.en: Half my paint is gone, showing iron.

lines.zh: 里面有个齿轮在刮壳子。
lines.en: A gear inside is scraping the shell.
The steam valve is stuck tight.

lines.zh: 停下来时，我听见炉膛里的心跳。
lines.en: When I stop, I hear the heartbeat in my furnace.
You're standing on the line. Move.

lines.zh: 你要下单吗？我不接零活。
lines.en: Placing an order? I don't do small jobs.

lines.zh: 你的靴子会被履带咬住。
lines.en: My treads will catch those boots.

lines.zh: 我在看你的尺寸，记下来。
lines.en: Measuring you. Noting it down.
Keep your hand out of the intake.

lines.zh: 你身上有机油味，你修过东西。
lines.en: You smell of grease. You've repaired things.

lines.zh: 我的镜片有点脏，看不清你。
lines.en: My lens is dirty; I can't see you clearly.
You're blocking my output.
Sir, please stand behind the yellow line.
Want to see what I make? Wait.
Shell dented. Function normal.
Not the furnace — it will blow.
My pressure is dropping.
A rivet flew off.

lines.zh: 我听见内部有东西断了。
lines.en: Something inside me snapped just now.
Minor damage. The line still runs.
My needle is in the red.
Steam leaks and scalds me.
Again and I must shut down.
Logging: damaged, continuing work.
Coal. Give me coal; my fire's low.

lines.zh: 那块铁，正好做一副骨架。
lines.en: That iron would make a fine frame.

lines.zh: 你的红石在响，我听见了。
lines.en: Your redstone hums. I hear it.

lines.zh: 一根木棍也能当燃料，别小看。
lines.en: Even a stick burns. Don't scoff.

lines.zh: 我闻到你包里的硫磺了。
lines.en: I smell sulfur in your pack.
Let me bite that copper ingot.
Rails? Tear them up. I can use them.
Any oil? My joints are screaming.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，只要够烧一夜。
lines.en: Not greedy. Just enough to burn one night.

lines.zh: 你手里那根火把，能借我点火吗？
lines.en: That torch — may I light up from it?

lines.zh: 咚，你听见了吗？是我撞你。
lines.en: Thud. Heard that? That was me.
Don't stand in my path.

lines.zh: 我的边角很硬，你会淤青。
lines.en: My corners are hard. You'll bruise.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的表针跳了一格。
lines.en: One bump and my needle jumped a notch.
Back up. Treads don't stop.
I rolled over your foot. Apologies.
You knocked off one of my guards.

lines.zh: 我们这样撞，谁都不划算。
lines.en: This collision profits neither of us.

lines.zh: 你把我侧面的铁皮撞凹了。
lines.en: You dented the plating along my left side.
Please go around. I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 另一台？工程师只造了我一台。
lines.en: Another? The engineer built only me.

lines.zh: 我们可以并排放，两条产线。
lines.en: We could sit side by side — two lines.
Are you made of iron too?
I can spare you half my parts.
Two of us roaring sounds like thunder.
Not too close; the steam burns.

lines.zh: 你有锅炉吗？我的快空了。
lines.en: Got a boiler? Mine's running dry.
Together we'd build more.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴，但我也不拒绝。
lines.en: I need no partner, but I won't refuse.
Slow down; my legs are short.

lines.zh: 这块废铁进炉，能出一支枪管。
lines.en: This scrap becomes a barrel in the furnace.
I pull it into the intake.
Whatever falls is raw material.

lines.zh: 这枚齿轮缺了齿，还能磨。
lines.en: This gear's chipped; still grindable.
I pick it up, weigh it. Passable.
Whose nail? It belongs to the line now.
No cloth. Iron, yes.

lines.zh: 我把它们码得整整齐齐。
lines.en: I stack them neat and square.
This heap makes two beepers.

lines.zh: 别捡那根，那是给 poker 的。
lines.en: Not that one; that's for a poker.
A living thing entered the perimeter.
Logging: one target, unregistered.
He stepped on the pressure plate.

lines.zh: 我看见金属反光，是武器。
lines.en: Metallic glint. A weapon.
Someone pushed the gate open.
Target halted. Observing me.

lines.zh: 我的手已经伸向出货口。
lines.en: My hand is already at the output.
Twelve blocks. In range.
He's counting my doors.

lines.zh: 订单来了，是不请自来的那种。
lines.en: An order arrived — the uninvited kind.
Hold still. Measuring your stride.

lines.zh: 你再走三步，就归 sniper 管。
lines.en: Three more steps and the sniper has you.

lines.zh: 我把你的位置刻在铜板上。
lines.en: I've etched your position on a copper plate.
Station one is ready.
My sight wobbles. Don't blame me.

lines.zh: 你听见滴答声了吗？那是 beeper。
lines.en: Hear that ticking? That's a beeper.

lines.zh: 你往左跑，那边也有我的人。
lines.en: Run left — my people are there too.
Hold that distance. Good.
Waiting for you to cross that line.
Calculation complete. You can't escape.

lines.zh: 我用整台机身的重量压过去。
lines.en: I throw my whole frame's weight at you.

lines.zh: 冲压头落下，正对你的肩。
lines.en: The stamp falls on your shoulder.
I don't punch. I ram.
That one went wide. Again.
Iron on bone makes a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我的挡板卡住了，等一下。
lines.en: My guard's stuck. One moment.
Retreat, and I press one step further.
I pin you to the conveyor.
Not so close; you'll get pulled in.
Output is up. I'm satisfied.
Ignite. Pressurize. I open.

lines.zh: 工程师退后两步，看着我立起来。
lines.en: The engineer steps back as I rise.

lines.zh: 第一声是我自己的轰鸣。
lines.en: The first sound is my own roar.

lines.zh: 炉膛里还有他留下的火星。
lines.en: Embers he left still glow inside me.

lines.zh: 我还没装完，就先站了起来。
lines.en: Unfinished, yet already standing.
Three blueprints are stuck to my chest.

lines.zh: 我把烟囱对准天空，吐了口气。
lines.en: I aim my stack skyward and exhale.

lines.zh: 这里的地够硬，能撑住我。
lines.en: The ground is hard enough to hold me.
Beginning warm-up. Please wait.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里就是产线。
lines.en: From today, this is the line.
Furnace too hot; my iron glows.
My base cracked on landing.
Water in the furnace. The fire dies.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我的门全掀开。
lines.en: The blast blew all my doors open.
An arrow lodged in my vents.
My needles spin wildly.
No fuel. The fire is shrinking.

lines.zh: 电流走遍全身，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Current floods me; I shudder once.
Falling, and the fire goes out first.
